title: José Aguilar Barroso (pharma Chief Commercial Officer) — 'if you change the players but the game stays the same, the players were never the problem'
summary: José Aguilar Barroso — pharma industry Chief Commercial Officer / VP Commercial — posts a substantive endorsement distilling Incorruptible's central argument to a single line about systems vs. players.
blockquote: Eric Ries makes a simple but great point: if you change the players but the game stays the same, the players were never the problem. The system is.
